ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-18-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Two Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William Gargano, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Lois Jones.
Petitioner: Sofia Tulchinsky, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Steven Alexis Gabriel and Jake Ivan Gabriel, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the two minors were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Steven Alexis Tulchinsky and Jake Ivan Tulchinsky.
Decree signed in open court.
